node_classes.how: GET /object_info on our ComfyUI 0.43.0 (read-only). value leaves out the partner API nodes (python_module comfy_api_nodes), which the open edition hides; all_loaded counts them too.

families_with_render.how: studio/family_status.json: families whose test level is render, the figure the Families page shows as rendered by the author. with_media_shipped counts the families with any media file in studio/web, some from a template's own example run.

graphs.how: GET /api/all-graphs on a studio of this checkout: counts.graph, the rows that open as a ComfyUI graph (goals, family templates, recipes, workflows, motion, voices, 3D). rows also counts the tools that run without a graph.

recipes.how: GET /api/recipe-library: total recipes in the library, and rendered, the ones with our own passed render shipped (studio/recipe_renders.json).

pipelines.how: GET /api/pipelines: every pipeline the page lists; with_a_run counts studio/web/pipelines/*/proof.json, the ones with a recorded run (passed or partial).

tabs.how: The TABS list in studio/web/app.js plus GET /api/feature-pages (one page per studio/feature_*.py that has a PAGE).

rendered_media.how: Files in studio/web: every video, sound and 3D file, and every picture that is not a still of one of those (poster frames, contact sheets, thumbnails, guides, and a commercial's shot frames are left out). Folders left out: icons, vendor, mesh_tools, site_examples, pack_lab_demos.

crew_notes.how: Markdown notes in studio/crew_notes/ (model family dossiers, studio topics), README.md not counted.

tests.how: python -m pytest --collect-only -q in this checkout: the tests collected.
